note: Corps of Engineers campground on the west shore of Lake Audubon, the only campground on the lake, beside the Audubon Wildlife Management Area. The outer row of the electric loop (016-030) sits on open grass just above the rocky shore; the inner sites look over them to the lake. Boat ramp, fish cleaning station and shoreline access area. --Claude
summary: rec.gov confirms 30 electric (7 at 50 A) + 10 non-electric sites, $22/$14 (2026 and 2027 peak), all reservable to the day, 14-night max, weekend 2/holiday 3 minimums, vault toilets, fill/dump station, drinking water. Lakefront STANDS on measurement: outer row 016, 018, 020, 022, 024, 026, 028, 029, 030 and Pike 034-035 are 18-38 m from the water over open grass and riprap. Phone missing: 701-654-7411.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, not --AWH): stands.
